primitives.name: Fan Type Profile
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Fan-type profiles** ("doorways"): user picks an identity — sharp bettor, film nerd, fantasy beginner, Sunday-only, learning football, here for the vibes — stored on the user profile.
primitives.assumptions: User selects one identity per session; identities map to interpretive registers.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Identity collapse at session boundary or explicit override.

layer2.mapping: Each fan type corresponds to a distinct conditional probability distribution over NFL explanation registers.
layer2.telemetry: User profile selection and session duration

primitives.name: Reader Mode Register
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Reader modes**: every explanation renders in up to three registers — *teach me* (beginner), *plain read* (default), *show me the math* (analyst).
primitives.assumptions: Three mutually exclusive registers; each maps to a distinct information density level.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Mode switch triggers re-render of explanation vector E.

layer2.mapping: Reader mode acts as a kernel function that transforms base NFL explanation into register-specific form.
layer2.telemetry: Toggle event and render time per register

primitives.name: Weekly NFL Ritual
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Doorway homepage framing**: belonging + intelligence before odds — within the existing chapter architecture, not replacing it.
primitives.assumptions: Ritual is deterministic across weeks; intelligence and belonging signals co-vary.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Ritual failure when I_W or B_W drop below threshold.

layer2.mapping: Weekly ritual maps to a temporal state transition in the NFL knowledge graph.
layer2.telemetry: Engagement rate and time-to-first-pick per week
